contexts.text: The making bare of the white which was upon the rods () = the disposition of the power of interior truth.
To be made bare () = to be deprived of truth.
Whence (the stripping and making bald of the trees in winter).
With denuding Thy bow shall be denuded () = that the doctrine of truth will be opened.

Stripping He hath stripped it, and cast it forth () = that there is no longer any good and truth which is not destroyed; to strip, namely, of fruits and leaves = of goods and truths; and to cast out = to utterly destroy.
He shall make bare its cedar () = the Rational destroyed.
Make thyself bare () = to adulterate the goods of the Word.
